name: ezone-api
description: EZONE serverless API (products, categories, checkout, orders). Node 20 Lambda behind API Gateway HTTP API.
comment: AWS SDK v3 (@aws-sdk/*) is preinstalled in the Lambda Node 20 runtime, so it is intentionally NOT vendored here. Install locally only to run the seed script: npm i @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb
